backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the ProFi Mine backend, defining data types for mining projects, user profiles, and subscription tiers, along with CRUD operations, financial calculations, export limit enforcement, and Stripe/HTTP outcall integrations.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two features: fixing PDF export to fully render all projections tab content, and fixing chart PNG export to correctly target the Recharts SVG element instead of the download button.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering components, hooks, utilities, contexts, and pages for the ProFi Mine React application.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens used throughout the application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for login, dashboard, payment success, and payment failure pages.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing loading state during authentication and clearing the React Query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for new users to enter their name, email, organization, and choose a free or premium subscription tier, then save the profile to the backend.
frontend/src/components/charts/CostBreak: Renders a pie chart breaking down total project costs (mining, processing, G&A, royalties, closure) using Recharts, with a download button that exports only the chart area as an image.
frontend/src/components/charts/Cumulativ: Renders a line chart of cumulative free cash flow over the project life using Recharts, starting from the negative initial capex, with a chart-only export button.
frontend/src/components/charts/Productio: Renders a bar chart of annual recovered metal production (in kg) using Recharts, with a chart-only image export button.
frontend/src/components/common/InfoToolt: A small reusable help-circle icon button that displays a tooltip with explanatory text when hovered.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Dashbo: Sticky top navigation header displaying the app logo, current project name, subscription tier usage indicators, and buttons for saving, loading, and authentication.
frontend/src/components/export/ExportTab: Export tab UI offering CSV and PDF download options, with free-tier export limit warnings and disabled states when the export quota is exhausted.
frontend/src/components/guide/Glossary.t: Searchable accordion glossary component that filters and displays term definitions from a constants file based on user input.
frontend/src/components/guide/UsageGuide: Usage guide tab with a sticky table of contents sidebar and a main content area rendering guide sections from constants plus the Glossary component.
frontend/src/components/inputs/CostStruc: Form section for entering mining cost structure inputs including initial/sustaining CAPEX, mining/processing/G&A costs per tonne, royalties, and depreciation method, using the ProjectContext for state management.
frontend/src/components/inputs/DynamicAr: Reusable component for editing a dynamic year-by-year numeric array, with add/remove year buttons and individual labeled inputs for each year.
frontend/src/components/inputs/EconomicP: Form section for entering economic parameters including inflation rate, discount rate, tax rate, and a dynamic per-year commodity price forecast in $/gram.
frontend/src/components/inputs/Financing: Form section for entering project financing parameters: equity ratio and interest rate, bound to ProjectContext state.
frontend/src/components/inputs/InputsTab: Composes all input form sections (Reserves & Production, Economic Parameters, Cost Structure, Financing) into a single card-based tab view.
frontend/src/components/inputs/ReservesP: Form section for entering ore reserves, grade, recovery rate, stripping ratio, and an annual ROM tonnage schedule using DynamicArrayInput.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Root layout component wrapping the app in a ThemeProvider, rendering the router Outlet, a Toaster, and a footer with branding.
frontend/src/components/layout/RootCompo: Top-level component that renders AppLayout and conditionally shows a ProfileSetupModal when an authenticated user has no profile yet.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentF: Full-page card displayed when a payment fails, listing common failure reasons and providing buttons to retry or contact support.
frontend/src/components/payment/PaymentS: Full-page card displayed after a successful payment that invalidates the user profile query to refresh subscription status and prompts navigation to the dashboard.
frontend/src/components/project/ProjectL: Modal dialog that lists saved projects with options to load or delete each one, using query hooks and toast notifications for feedback.
frontend/src/components/project/SaveProj: Modal dialog for saving a project by name, enforcing subscription-based usage limits and prompting an upgrade modal when the limit is reached.
frontend/src/components/projections/Cash: Renders a scrollable table showing yearly OCF, CAPEX, closure costs, free cash flow, and cumulative FCF from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/projections/Inco: Renders a scrollable yearly income statement table with revenue, OPEX, royalties, EBITDA, taxes, and net income from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/projections/Proj: Composes the full projections view by combining KPI summary, charts (cash flow, production, cost breakdown), income statement, and cash flow statement cards.
frontend/src/components/projections/Summ: Displays a simple two-column table of key financial KPIs (NPV, IRR, ROI, LOM, EBITDA, payback period) derived from project calculations.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Scen: Shows a comparison table of NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM across base, optimistic, and pessimistic scenarios, with edit buttons that open a ScenarioEditor dialog.

A dialog component for editing scenario parameters (base, optimistic, pessimistic) that allows users to adjust commodity price, ore grade, recovery rate, CAPEX, and OPEX as percentage changes, saving updates via ScenarioContext.
frontend/src/components/sensitivity/Sens: A UI panel with sliders for adjusting five key mining variables (±20%) and displays adjusted NPV, IRR, and ROI results compared to base values using the SensitivityContext.
A tab layout component that composes SensitivityControls, SensitivityTornado, and ScenarioComparison into two cards for sensitivity analysis and scenario comparison.
Renders a horizontal tornado bar chart using Recharts showing the NPV impact of ±20% variation in key variables, sourced from SensitivityContext's tornadoData.
frontend/src/components/subscription/Sub: A modal dialog displaying current tier usage and upgrade options that initiates a Stripe checkout session for a Premium subscription when the user clicks upgrade.
frontend/src/config/stripe.ts: Exports the Stripe publishable key constant for use in frontend payment integrations.
frontend/src/constants/glossary.ts: Exports a record mapping mining and financial term keys to their plain-English definitions for use in tooltips or help text throughout the app.
frontend/src/constants/guideContent.ts: Exports structured guide content with sections covering application overview, getting started steps, input parameter explanations, and calculation formulas for the user help guide.
frontend/src/contexts/ProjectContext.tsx: Provides a React context for managing mining project state, including financial inputs, calculations, project save/load operations, and user subscription tier/usage data fetched from the backend.
frontend/src/contexts/ScenarioContext.ts: Provides a React context for managing three financial scenarios (base, optimistic, pessimistic) by applying percentage adjustments to project inputs and recalculating NPV, IRR, ROI, and LOM. Wraps children with SensitivityProvider.
frontend/src/contexts/SensitivityContext: Provides a React context for sensitivity analysis, computing adjusted financial results based on user-defined parameter changes and generating tornado chart data by varying each input ±20%.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, reinitializing and invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useChartExport.ts: Custom hook that exports a chart's SVG element to a PNG file by cloning the SVG, inlining computed styles, rendering to a 2x-resolution canvas, and triggering a download.
frontend/src/hooks/useCreateCheckoutSess: Custom hook that exposes a React Query mutation to call the backend's createCheckoutSession method with shopping items and return/cancel URLs, parsing the JSON response into a Stripe checkout session object.
frontend/src/hooks/useExcelExport.ts: Hook that exports project financial data as a CSV file, checking export permissions via the backend actor and decrementing the user's export count before triggering a download.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, and persisting identity state across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/usePdfExport.ts: Hook that exports the current project view as a PDF by verifying export permissions, decrementing the export count, and triggering the browser's print dialog after ensuring the DOM is fully rendered.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralizes React Query hooks for backend interactions including fetching/saving user profiles, loading/deleting projects, and managing Stripe configuration via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet defining Tailwind base layers, mining-themed CSS custom properties for light/dark modes, and print styles that isolate the projections tab content for PDF export.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page that renders a five-tab interface (Inputs, Projections, Sensitivity, Export, Guide) wrapped in ProjectProvider and ScenarioProvider, redirecting unauthenticated users to the home page.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Login page component that redirects authenticated users to the dashboard and displays a branded login UI with Internet Identity authentication for the ProFi Mine app.
frontend/src/types/external.d.ts: Empty TypeScript declaration file intended for external module type definitions.
frontend/src/utils/calculations.ts: Defines financial calculation logic for mining projects, including interfaces for inputs and yearly data, and functions to compute NPV, IRR, ROI, EBITDA, and cash flows over a multi-year schedule.
frontend/src/utils/formatters.ts: Provides utility functions for formatting numbers as currency, percentages, plain numbers, and dates for display in the UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom OKLCH-based color tokens, border radius variables, accordion animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking two known bugs to fix: PDF exports not rendering financial projections correctly, and chart image exports capturing the download button instead of the chart SVG.
